suite: G002 advisor_20260301 server-side advisor tool -- adversarial QA (executor lane)

scope.target: SamplerConfig.advisor_server_model gate (advisor_gate_active, client.rs:1048) driving the advisor-tool-2026-03-01 beta and the raw advisor_20260301 tool injection (inject_messages_extra_tools) into Anthropic Messages requests, plus the SessionActor::reconstruct_full_config wiring
scope.constraint: implementation is FROZEN; only tests + this artifact were added; no defects found so no fixes were made
scope.existing_matrix_extended: 7 pre-existing sampler tests incl. the 24-combo advisor_matrix_cartesian_sweep (advisor_probe helper) in crates/codegen/xai-grok-sampler/src/client.rs

cases.name: non_streaming_create_message_injects_advisor_tool_on_the_wire
cases.expected: Non-streaming create_message (via conversation_messages) with the gate active injects the advisor_20260301 tool into the literal outgoing JSON body and the advisor-tool-2026-03-01 beta into the outgoing anthropic-beta header, verified against the real bytes received by a live mock HTTP server (not just at the private inject_messages_extra_tools call level).

cases.name: streaming_create_message_stream_injects_advisor_tool_on_the_wire
cases.expected: Streaming create_message_stream (via conversation_stream_messages) with the gate active ALSO injects the advisor_20260301 tool + advisor-tool-2026-03-01 beta on the wire, proven against a real SSE mock server round-trip. Adversarial hypothesis under test: the streaming path silently skips injection. Result: it does not -- both call sites route through the same apply_anthropic_cli_headers / inject_messages_extra_tools calls with no path-dependent branching.

cases.name: advisor_beta_tool_never_diverge_across_matrix
cases.expected: Across the full 3(backend) x 2(auth_scheme) x 2(adapter) x 2(model) = 24-combination axis matrix, anthropic-beta presence == advisor_20260301 tool presence in EVERY combination (dedicated coupling invariant, independent of whether advisor_gate_active()'s own formula is correct -- catches an asymmetric regression that breaks only one of the two).

cases.name: advisor_matrix_cartesian_sweep (pre-existing, re-verified)
cases.expected: Across the same 24-combination matrix, beta==tool==expected where expected = (Messages && Bearer && anthropic_adapter && model.is_some()) -- the full gate formula, not just the coupling invariant.

cases.name: advisor_absent_for_responses_backend (pre-existing, re-verified)
cases.expected: Mixed negative axis: Responses backend + Bearer + anthropic adapter + model set (single wrong axis = backend) -> both beta and tool absent.

cases.name: advisor_absent_for_chat_completions_backend / advisor_absent_for_x_api_key_scheme / advisor_absent_for_non_anthropic_adapter / advisor_absent_when_model_none (pre-existing, re-verified)
cases.expected: Each remaining negative axis in isolation (ChatCompletions backend; XApiKey scheme with Messages+anthropic+model set -- the second mixed-axis case the assignment names; non-Anthropic adapter; advisor_server_model=None) suppresses both beta and tool.
cases.command: cargo test -p xai-grok-sampler --lib advisor_absent_for_chat_completions_backend advisor_absent_for_x_api_key_scheme advisor_absent_for_non_anthropic_adapter advisor_absent_when_model_none

cases.name: advisor_tool_shape_matches_configured_model_exactly
cases.expected: The injected tool is exactly {"type":"advisor_20260301","name":"advisor","model":<configured model>} with no extra/missing fields, and two distinct configured models produce two distinct model field values -- proves the model is threaded through advisor_server_model, not hardcoded.

cases.name: advisor_tool_appended_without_dropping_existing_tools
cases.expected: When the gate is active AND the request body already has client-side tools populated in body["tools"], the advisor tool is APPENDED after them without dropping or reordering the pre-existing entries.

cases.name: advisor_server_model_present_when_all_axes_align
cases.expected: SessionActor::reconstruct_full_config: server_advisor=true + Messages + anthropic adapter + the default (Bearer) auth_scheme resolves advisor_server_model = Some(the active model). Bearer is AuthScheme's #[default] variant, so a fresh ModelAuthFacts memo (no live Anthropic OAuth credential needed) already reaches Bearer -- the positive leg is genuinely reachable hermetically, contrary to an initial assumption that it required live OAuth state.

cases.name: advisor_server_model_none_when_server_advisor_flag_is_false
cases.expected: server_advisor=false suppresses advisor_server_model even with Messages + anthropic adapter otherwise eligible.

cases.name: advisor_server_model_none_when_backend_is_not_messages
cases.expected: A non-Messages backend (ChatCompletions) suppresses advisor_server_model even with server_advisor=true and an anthropic adapter set.

cases.name: advisor_server_model_none_when_auth_scheme_is_not_bearer
cases.expected: Forcing auth_scheme=XApiKey via the model_auth_facts test memo (hermetic stand-in for the live-credential override branch) suppresses advisor_server_model even with server_advisor/Messages/anthropic-adapter all set -- a single wrong axis suppresses the whole gate on the shell wiring side too.
